observed.caption: Aerial view of white wind turbines lined along a dry hilltop ridge overlooking patchwork farmland and settlements under a pale blue sky.
observed.description: The photo shows a high-altitude aerial view taken from an aircraft, with the dark curved edge of an airplane window visible in the bottom left corner. A prominent dry, brownish ridge with scattered green vegetation and dark tree clusters runs diagonally through the middle ground, lined with numerous white wind turbines with tall towers and blades. To the left of the ridge, flat arid plains stretch toward a hazy horizon with distant low mountains and hills. To the right and below the ridge, the landscape consists of a patchwork of small agricultural fields in brown and green tones, dense dark green vegetation patches, and clustered light-colored buildings forming settlements. The upper portion of the image is a pale to medium blue sky with thin, wispy white clouds and soft haze near the horizon, illuminated by bright natural daylight.
